notes: Faraway, Extending the Linear Model with R (ELM): one-way random effects on shift operator (a-d), 5 reps each. Help states the design, model recalled from the book.
Faraway ELM crossed random effects: 3 operators x 8 resin railcars, 2 samples per cell. Model recalled from the book.
Faraway ELM randomised complete block design, litters (block) as random; 6 diets, 10 litters of 3. Model recalled from the book.
Faraway ELM repeated measures with random slopes; 27 rats, 5 weekly weights, drinking-water additive. Model recalled from the book.
Faraway ELM longitudinal data; log income with person-specific intercept and year slope (the book centres year as cyear). Model recalled from the book.
Multicentre longitudinal onychomycosis trial; random-intercept logistic (Lesaffre & Spiessens 2001, cited on the page; Fitzmaurice, Laird & Ware). visit is an alternate time index.
Faraway ELM nested random effects; 7 subjects, both eyes at 4 lens powers, eye nested in subject. Model recalled from the book.

Split-plot (Littell et al., SAS System for Mixed Models, Data Set 2.2(b); also in SASmixed). Grp = ET:Wafer whole plot (stored ordered, treated as nominal id); Wafer is the whole-plot replicate within ET.

Incomplete block design: plate (4 plates, 3 resistors each) is the block, shape (A-D) the treatment. No model stated; rendered as the random-effects version per Census blocking rule, fixed fit noise ~ shape + plate.

RCBD: 5 varieties across 5 plots (replicate = plot as block). failure is failures out of 100 seeds (binomial, 100 trials, but no trials column so filed count). No model stated; rendered random per Census blocking rule, fixed fit failure ~ variety + replicate.

Block = experimenter (blocking factor); Height, Frequency and resting heart rate fixed; Order is run order (ignored). No model stated; rendered random per Census blocking rule, fixed fit HR ~ Height*Frequency + RestHR.

Faraway ELM binomial overdispersion example (fixed fit glm cbind(survive, total-survive) ~ location + period). location = stream block (5), period = retrieval time; rendered with location random per Census blocking rule.
